review_kind: retrospective qualitative source-expectation screen, not empirical validation or a blind forecast
method: Two bounded independent saved-evidence reviews cover the92 completed cases; all108 refusal diagnostics were inspected.
Compare supplied qualitative expectations with saved solution species, product inventory, pH trajectories, events and rendered scenes.
Initial trapped air and solvent are baseline inventory, not reaction products; analytical contents are not automatically free-ion concentrations.
Principal-observation alignment does not validate yields, rates, complete mechanism, every source clause or untested reverse arms.
Categories route follow-up work; protocol and model causes can overlap. No original forecasts or physical pass counts were changed.

interpretation_notes: The adapter uses PHREEQC pH charge adjustment for non-H/O analytical totals. Incomplete bare-ion inputs cannot be interpreted as complete physical solutions.
Bare H+/OH- solvent-only readings are a real reporting boundary; complete HCl/NaOH stocks independently give the expected acid/base and neutralisation response.
Separate pre-frozen complete-stock followups distinguish protocol mistakes from product gaps; their results do not rewrite the original 200 observations or validate their procedures.
